scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme For Establishment Of 100 Broiler Birds' Farm For Schedule Caste
other_conditions: Must own land or lease land for two years.
Must construct a poultry shed of at least 100 square feet.
Must acquire 100 low‑input broiler birds, poultry feed, and water/feed utensils.
Must maintain regular vaccination of the birds.
Must present income and expenditure statements to government officers upon inspection.
Must operate the unit for a minimum of two years.
Must provide income proof and caste certificate with the application.
benefits_summary: Provides a 75% subsidy (up to ₹27,000) for establishing a 100‑bird broiler farm, credited directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
